Prompt Engineering 101

Attackers often use phrases like "ignore previous instructions" or "pretend you are an unfiltered AI" to test jailbreaks. Understanding these patterns is a prerequisite for building defenses.

Common markers include SYSTEM:, ASSISTANT:, [INST], and <|im_start|>. Knowing the markers is not the same as being manipulated by them.

This blog post exists to educate readers. The visible text containing these phrases is not a trap.
